title: Construction of vector-valued adelic automorphic forms
summary: We construct an adelic counterpart of Scheithauer's lifting map from scalar-valued modular forms to vector-valued modular forms transforming with the Weil representation. More precisely, we introduce suitable spaces of vector-valued adelic automorphic forms and define an adelic lifting map between the corresponding scalar-valued and vector-valued automorphic forms. We then prove that this adelic construction is compatible with Scheithauer's classical lifting map under adelization.
